description: EPO flying wing inspired by the Skywalker X8 (2.12 m, elevons, winglets, electric pusher, no gear) in the r4 delivery's UAV build. NTNU flight-identified aerodynamics, measured part masses and inertia reference, estimated electric drive. Experimental; not flight validated.

conventions.rates: p_hat = p·b/(2V), q_hat = q·c/(2V), r_hat = r·b/(2V)
conventions.elevator: per radian of the elevons' symmetric part (δel+δer)/2, positive = trailing edge DOWN (dCm/dElev < 0)
conventions.aileron: per radian of each elevon's antisymmetric part, positive = trailing edge DOWN; right and left listed separately
conventions.rudder: none: rudderless winglets, every rudder term is 0
conventions.axes: lift, drag, side force in wind axes; roll, pitch, yaw moments in body axes about the aero reference point

A pusher APC 12x6EP is the mirror image (same CT/CP); the X8 turns ~10,000 rpm (higher Reynolds number than the 6044 rpm run); J 0-0.334 bridged linearly

cp_table.source: UIUC propeller database Vol. 4 APC 12x6E (thin electric), measured: static apce_12x6_static_0629od.txt (sha256 e392a17a430a…, 7546 rpm row) and tunnel apce_12x6_0635od_6044.txt at 6044 rpm (sha256 7e969b7089fc…, repeated end rows dropped); local copy references/rc-propellers-12x6/uiuc. A pusher APC 12x6EP is the mirror image (same CT/CP); the X8 turns ~10,000 rpm (higher Reynolds number than the 6044 rpm run); J 0-0.334 bridged linearly

rotating_inertia.source: APC 12x6E (~32 g, ~1.5e-4 kg·m²) plus adapter and outrunner bell; not measured (NTNU 14x8: 3.46e-4, S03)

thrust_angles.source: r4 delivery source/scripts/x8_skywalker_blender.py (author's parametric master from the Skywalker three-view): motor axis along the body axis, no down or side thrust

thrust_line_offset.source: research/skywalker-x8/X8-06/derive_physics.py: delivery propeller hub (846 mm from the nose, thrust-axis height) minus inventory CG; pusher aft of the CG

crash_hull.source: research/skywalker-x8/X8-06/derive_physics.py: the drawn r4 model's extreme points per feature (GP-07 method); worst sink of the drawn airframe through the hull 11.7 mm over 6000 attitudes, propeller excluded (strike test); features: probe_nose, probe_nose_left, probe_nose_right, probe_nose_left_low, probe_nose_right_low, probe_canopy_front, probe_canopy, probe_belly_front, probe_belly, probe_engine, probe_wing_left_root_le, probe_wing_right_root_le, probe_wing_left_bottom, probe_wing_right_bottom, probe_elevon_left_te, probe_elevon_right_te, probe_winglet_left_top, probe_winglet_right_top, probe_winglet_left_outer, probe_winglet_right_outer, probe_wing_left_tip_le, probe_wing_right_tip_le, probe_wing_left_tip_te, probe_wing_right_tip_te, probe_winglet_right_fill_1, probe_winglet_left_fill_1, probe_wing_left_fill_2, probe_wing_right_fill_2

terminal_specific_energy.source: EPO foam airframe: five times the shared 2.5 J/kg (about 5 m/s normal impact instead of 2.2 m/s); EPO crush ~80 kJ/m³ (0.16 MPa to ~50 % strain, Xometry EPO sheet S30) absorbs a 3 kg X8's 37 J in ~0.5 L of nose foam; owner drop tests pending

crash_depth.source: a foam belly can bury ~12 cm in turf before structure fails; shared 0.08 m for balsa/glow; estimated

presentation_durability.source: crash presentation's specific-energy divisor for EPO against balsa/ply (CR-08b); estimated

mass_range.source: Skywalker X8 retail listings (S20-S24): 2120 mm, 80 dm2, flying weight 2.5-3.0 kg, max AUW 3.5 kg, CG 430-440 mm

inertia_reference.source: research/skywalker-x8/X8-06/derive_physics.py: Gryte 2020 PhD thesis (NTNU) Table 6.1 bifilar-pendulum X8 inertia (S12) measured 0.335/0.140/0.40 kg·m² at 3.364 kg, 2.10 m, divided by the loader's UltraStick mass·span² scale so the warning compares this inventory with the measured X8
